info.name: Ecommerce Microservices
info.description:
API collection for Auth, Product, Inventory, and Order services.

All requests go through the API Gateway at {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:7999).

**Auth flow:**
1. Register → Verify Email → Login → Use token for protected endpoints.
2. Login response sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` variables automatically.

**Product flow:**
1. Create Category / Brand first.
2. Create Product with categoryId and brandId.
3. Create Variants under a Product.

**Inventory flow:**
1. Inventory is auto-created via Kafka when a variant is created.
2. Use Update Stock to add/subtract/set stock levels.
3. Use Reservations for order checkout flow.

**Order flow:**
1. Create Order → status PENDING → Kafka saga reserves stock.
2. Poll GET order to check STOCK_RESERVED → Confirm → Processing → Ship → Deliver.

item.name: Public
item.description: Endpoints that do NOT require a JWT token.

request.description:
Register a new user.

Password must contain: uppercase, digit, special character, min 8 chars.
Verify user email with the token received via email.

Login and receive access + refresh tokens.

Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables.
Request a password reset email.

Reset password using the token received via email.

Password must contain: uppercase, digit, special character, min 8 chars.

item.name: Protected
item.description: Endpoints that require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header.

request.description: Get a new access token using the refresh token.

Change password for the authenticated user.

New password must contain: uppercase, digit, special character, min 8 chars.

Logout and blacklist the current token.

Clears saved tokens on success.

item.name: Product Service
item.description: Product catalog management: Categories, Brands, Products, and Variants.

request.description:
Create a new product category.

Set `parentId` to create a sub-category.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "iPhone 15 Pro",
    "description": "Latest iPhone with A17 Pro chip",
    "baseSku": "IPHONE-15-PRO",
    "price": 999.99,
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/images/iphone15pro.png",
    "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
    "brandId": "{{brandId}}"
}

request.description:
Create a new product.

Requires `categoryId` and `brandId` (optional, can be null).

body.raw:
{
    "name": "iPhone 15 Pro Max",
    "description": "Updated description for iPhone 15 Pro Max",
    "baseSku": "IPHONE-15-PRO-MAX",
    "price": 1199.99,
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/images/iphone15promax.png",
    "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
    "brandId": "{{brandId}}"
}

request.description:
Delete a product and all its variants.

Publishes PRODUCT_DELETED Kafka events per variant.

item.name: Product Variants
item.description: CRUD operations for product variants (size, color, material).

request.description:
Create a variant under a product.

Publishes VARIANT_CREATED Kafka event → inventory-service auto-creates inventory record.

Update a product variant.

Publishes VARIANT_UPDATED Kafka event → inventory-service updates metadata.

Delete a product variant.

Publishes VARIANT_DELETED Kafka event → inventory-service deactivates inventory record.

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Stock reservation operations for order checkout flow.

request.description:
Reserve stock for a single item.

Idempotent: orderId + sku combination prevents duplicates.

Default expiration: 15 minutes.

Reserve stock for multiple items in a single atomic operation.

Used during cart checkout.

Actions: FULFILL, RELEASE.

item.name: Order Service
item.description:
Order lifecycle management with Kafka saga pattern.

Flow: PENDING → STOCK_RESERVED → CONFIRMED → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED

body.raw:
{
    "items": [
        {
            "sku": "IPHONE-15-PRO-BLK-256",
            "productId": "{{productId}}",
            "variantId": "{{variantId}}",
            "productName": "iPhone 15 Pro",
            "variantName": "Black Titanium / 256GB",
            "quantity": 1,
            "unitPrice": 999.99
        }
    ],
    "shippingAddressLine1": "123 Main Street",
    "shippingAddressLine2": "Apt 4B",
    "shippingCity": "Ho Chi Minh City",
    "shippingState": "HCM",
    "shippingZipCode": "700000",
    "shippingCountry": "Vietnam",
    "currency": "USD",
    "notes": "Please handle with care"
}

request.description:
Create a new order (async saga).

Returns immediately with status PENDING (HTTP 202).
Kafka saga will reserve stock automatically.

Poll GET /api/orders/{id} to check status:
- PENDING → STOCK_RESERVED (success)
- PENDING → FAILED (insufficient stock)

Get order details by UUID.

Use this to poll for status changes after order creation.
Get order details by human-readable order number.

query.description: Filter by status (optional): PENDING, STOCK_RESERVED, CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, FAILED

request.description:
Get current user's orders (paginated).

Optionally filter by status.

Confirm order after stock is reserved.

Requires order status to be STOCK_RESERVED.

Transition: STOCK_RESERVED → CONFIRMED

Cancel an order.

Publishes ORDER_CANCELLED Kafka event → inventory-service releases reservations.

Can cancel from most non-terminal states.

Mark order as processing (packaging/preparing).

Requires ADMIN role.

Transition: CONFIRMED → PROCESSING

Mark order as shipped.

Requires ADMIN role.

Transition: PROCESSING → SHIPPED

Mark order as delivered.

Requires ADMIN role.

Transition: SHIPPED → DELIVERED

Publishes ORDER_COMPLETED Kafka event → inventory-service fulfills reservations.

query.description: Order status: PENDING, STOCK_RESERVED, CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, FAILED
